text: This report recommends that the name "Alley Cat Lane" be approved to identify an existing public lane located east of Bathurst Street, extending northerly from Nassau Street. Community Councils have delegated authority to decide street naming matters which comply with the City of Toronto Street Naming Policy.
The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Approved the name "Alley Cat Lane" for an existing public lane located east of Bathurst Street, extending northerly from Nassau Street.
